title: Jimmy Elk — Air Force basic training
text:
Jimmy Elk

BASIC training is nearing its end for Jimmy R. Elk, son of Mr. and Mrs. R. C. Elk of Savoy, a recent enlistee in the Air Force, Elk is getting his indoctrination course at Lackland AFB San Antonio.
notes: Photo of young man in Air Force uniform and cap. Caption 'Jimmy Elk' beneath photo.
